systems.country_label: Censo Escolar de Principio de Curso; Anuario Estadístico de la Educación
systems.owner: Unidad de Estadística e Investigación, Dirección General de Planificación, Programación y Desarrollo Educativo, Ministry of Education and Science; supported by PRODEGE, funded by the government and Hess Corporation and administered by FHI360
systems.tiers: each public or private school reports by questionnaire at the start of the school year; the district inspectorates follow up and pass it on; the central statistics unit processes and publishes; 802 primary schools reported in 2014-2015, fewer than in 2011-2012

systems.country_label: Sistema de Información y Mapa Escolar (SIME), which the abbreviations list gives as the Spanish rendering of EMIS
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Science, Unidad de Estadística e Investigación, set up in 2007 under PRODEGE
systems.tiers: central: an education statistics system that follows the census collection and automates processing, validation and dissemination; gives statistics and indicators at each geographic level and for each school through a school report

note: No fact: the yearbook describes the annual school census and SIME, which it calls an EMIS but describes only as the statistics system built on the census; the passages describe no entry by schools other than the yearly questionnaire.
